title: Easy Crockpot Tuscan Chicken Recipe | Slow Cooker Chicken
description:
Learn how to make an incredible, flavorful crockpot Tuscan chicken! In this easy slow cooker recipe, tender chicken breasts simmer slowly with sun-dried tomatoes, spinach, garlic, and savory Italian seasonings until juicy and infused with rich flavor. It’s the ultimate dump-and-go comfort meal for busy weeknights that the whole family will love.

Serve it warm over a bed of fluffy white rice, pasta, or with crusty garlic bread to soak up all that delicious sauce.
